contractNotice: All terms, milestone percentages, warranties, and itemized scopes are stated in a binding written contract before any physical work begins.

tradeWarranties.covered: Membrane delamination, water ponding leakage, ceiling seepage to floor below
tradeWarranties.notCovered: Post-handover drilling into floor slab by 3rd parties, structural building movement

tradeWarranties.covered: Hollow tiles, tile debonding, hairline grout cracking, uneven joint rectification
tradeWarranties.notCovered: Physical impact chipping from dropped heavy objects, cleaning with harsh unauthorized acids

tradeWarranties.covered: Door hinge sagging, drawer track misalignment, edge banding delamination
tradeWarranties.notCovered: Direct water soaking of internal carcass boards, deliberate overloading beyond shelf limits

tradeWarranties.covered: Joint leakages, concealed pipe connection defects, breaker wiring faults
tradeWarranties.notCovered: Client-supplied light fixtures, external appliances, user short-circuits

paymentSchedule.description: Upon contract confirmation, architectural layout finalization, and HDB/BCA permit submission.
Upon site protection setup, commencement of hacking, and delivery of raw building materials.
Upon completion of piping, waterproofing ponding test clearance, masonry, tiling, and false ceiling framing.
Upon installation of custom cabinetry, doors, sanitary wares, electrical fittings, and initial painting.
Only after joint defect walkthrough inspection, final acid washing, and formal handover of keys.

checklist: 100% itemized line items with exact unit prices (per sqft / foot run)
Clear material brands specified (e.g. Nippon Paint, Sika, Blum, Saint-Gobain)
Exact milestone payment schedule and timeline breakdown
No hidden buffers or surprise variation clauses
Formal company UEN, registration details, and licensed scope
Signed structural warranty coverage duration per trade
